svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Buy a plain steel tray about 460 x 300 x 45 mm, 1.5 mm wall, with a flat

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: floor at least 457 x 297 mm inside. No plastic coating.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two fan intake slots in the back wall, 56 wide x 22 tall, from 20 to 42 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: up from the floor, centred 110 mm left and 50 mm right of the centre.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill 6 mm in each corner, cut between with a hacksaw or nibbler, file.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Six 4.5 mm holes in the floor for the foot studs, 124 mm each side of

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the centre line front to back, at 210 mm left, 45 mm left and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 120 mm right of centre. Measure from the centre lines you scribe.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Deburr every cut edge inside and out; touch up bare steel with paint.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: a rubber foot under each hole; its stud goes up into a standoff.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the six holes match the base plate's corner holes when the plate

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: is laid on top, centred, before the liner goes in.
